lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in roughly horizontal rows across the visible lateral flank, with a higher concentration of centroids appearing in the mid-flank region anterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a grid-like anchor system where high-luminance spots are positioned at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-intensity pixels (dorsal) to low-intensity shadow pixels (ventral).

other_distinctive_markers: A vertically oriented, high-luminance elongated pixel cluster is present on the body wall immediately dorsal to the pectoral fin insertion point.
